Halı sahada ihtiyacınız olan her şey için Halısahavar yanınızda!

*** Halı sahaların vazgeçilmezi Halısahavar şimdi IOS’ta! ***
	
Halı saha tutkunlarının hayatını kolaylaştıran Halısahavar mobil uygulaması, futbolseverler için birçok yenilik sunuyor. Bu yenilikler, halı saha organizasyonlarında yaşadığınız sorunları da geride bırakıyor. Halısahavar mobil ile halı sahada aradığınız her şey hizmetinizde!

HALI SAHA PARTNERİNİ BUL!
	Halı sahada kendine partner mi arıyorsun? Halısahavar, bu yüzden var. Halısahavar ile oyuncu, maç, rakip arayabilir, sahalar hakkında bilgi alabilir ve turnuvalara katılabilirsin!

ADAM MI EKSİK?
	Maçın başlamasına dakikalar kala eksik mi kaldınız? Yenge en önemli oyuncunuzu kadrodan mı çıkardı? Üzülmeyin. Halısahavar mobil ile yakınınızdaki oyuncular için ilan oluşturabilir, eksik mevkiye oyuncu arayabilir ve yeni halı saha oyuncularıyla eşleşebilirsiniz.

SAHADA DİŞİNİZE GÖRE RAKİP Mİ YOK?
	Çok güçlü ve atletik bir takıma sahipseniz galibiyet serisi kaçınılmaz oluyor, ama unutmayın. Los Galacticos bile her maçı kazanamadı. Galibiyet serinizi sona erdirecek takımı Halısahavar üzerinden bulabilir, sahada kıyasıya mücadele edebilirsiniz.

CANINIZ MAÇ YAPMAK MI İSTİYOR?
	Bazen bireysel olarak halı saha yapmak isteseniz de arkadaşlarınız uygun olmayabilir. Bu durumlarda Halısahavar mobil uygulamasından maç arayarak maçlara katılabilir, oynama hevesinizi sahaya yansıtabilirsiniz!

TAKIMIN KAPTANI OL!
	Hayalini kurduğun takımı kur, transferini yap ve futbolcu ruhunu sahaya yansıt! Halısahavar ile takım oluşturabilir, diziliş belirleyebilir ve formsuz oyuncuları yedek kulübesinde oturtabilirsin. Takımına yıldız oyuncuları transfer ederek daha güçlü bir takıma sahip olabilirsin.

HALISAHAVAR KARTINI OLUŞTUR!
	Mevkini seç, özelliklerini belirle, oyuncu arayan takımların karşısına çık! Halısahavar ile Halısahavar (HSV) kartını oluşturabilir, profesyonel bir halı saha oyuncusu deneyimi yaşayabilirsin.

6760619531.releaseNotes:
New Feature: Home Screen Widgets are Here!

Dear iOS users, to help you track your match schedules more easily and efficiently, we have integrated full Apple Widget support into the app.

• Individual Match Posts: When you create an individual match post, you can now track its expiration time directly from your iOS home screen without opening the app.

• Team vs. Team Events: For Team vs. Team matches, your entire squad can now track the post expiration time or the exact scheduled match time with your matched opponent right from the home screen.

• • •> How to Add: Long-press the app icon (or anywhere on your home screen) and tap the "+" icon in the top left corner. Search for Maçla in the "Add Widget" menu. Tap our widget and place it anywhere on your home screen for easy access. Have a great match!

Performance Improvements & Bug Fixes

• Smooth Chat Experience: The individual chat detail screen in the Messages tab has been fully optimized to run flawlessly at 60 FPS.

• Navigation Fix: Resolved a freezing issue that occurred when switching to the Messages tab from the bottom navigation bar on slow internet connections.

• Message Deletion Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where tapping "delete message" would fail to register if a new message arrived while the deletion confirmation dialog was open.

6761342905.description:
Halı saha maçını dakikalar içinde kur, eksik oyuncunu bul, sahaya çık.

Altıpas; halı saha oyuncularını, takımları ve maçları tek uygulamada buluşturan ücretsiz sosyal futbol platformudur. Topluluğunu kur, kadronu topla, rakibini bul ve maç sonrası performansını takip et.

MAÇINI DAKİKALAR İÇİNDE KUR
Tarih, saat ve sahayı belirle, topluluğuna bildirim gitsin. WhatsApp grubundaki kadro listesini yapıştır; kadron ve dizilişin saniyeler içinde hazır olsun. Geçmiş maçından tek dokunuşla yeni maç kur, kadro aynen gelsin.

EKSİK OYUNCU BUL
Kadron eksikse tek maçlık ilan ver, çevrendeki uygun oyunculara anında haber gitsin. Kaleci mi arıyorsun, forvet mi; mevkiyi ve ilçeyi sen seç.

RAKİP BUL
Takımın hazır ama rakip yok mu? Rakip ilanı ver, seviyene ve bölgene uygun takımlarla eşleş, maçı konuşup sahaya çık.

TAKIM VE KADRO YÖNETİMİ
A ve B takımlarını dengeli kur, oyuncuları saha üzerinde mevkilerine yerleştir, diziliş editörüyle taktiğini belirle. Misafir oyuncu ekle, kimin geleceğini tek ekrandan takip et.

OYUNCU KARTIN VE İSTATİSTİKLERİN
Her maç sonrası yapılan değerlendirmelerle gelişen bir oyuncu kartın oluşur. Maç sayısı, galibiyet, gol, asist ve MVP oyların profilinde birikir; topluluk sıralamasında yüksel.

TOPLULUK VE SOHBET
Mahallendeki, iş yerindeki veya arkadaş grubundaki oyuncularla topluluk kur. Topluluk sohbetinde maçı konuş, anket aç, kadroyu birlikte belirle.

ÇEVRENDEKİ MAÇLAR VE OYUNCULAR
İlçendeki toplulukları, açık ilanları ve yeni oyuncuları keşfet. Şehrindeki oyunculara mesaj at, düzenli kadronu zamanla büyüt.

TURNUVALAR VE KULÜP SEÇMELERİ
Altıpas turnuvalarını keşfet, takımınla kayıt ol; fikstürü, skorları ve puan durumunu uygulamadan takip et. Bölgendeki kulüplerin açtığı seçme ilanlarını gör, uygun olanlara başvur.

SAHALAR
Çevrendeki halı sahaları keşfet, saha bilgilerini incele ve varsa canlı yayın bağlantısına ulaş.

HATIRLATMALAR
Maç saati yaklaşınca, kadro değişince veya sana bir ilan geldiğinde bildirim al. Hangi bildirimleri alacağını ayarlardan sen belirle.

UYGULAMADA OLMAYAN ARKADAŞLARIN İÇİN
Maç bağlantısını paylaş; arkadaşların uygulamayı indirmeden linke tıklayıp kadrodaki yerini alsın.

Altıpas ücretsizdir. Google, Apple veya e-posta ile saniyeler içinde katılabilir, uygulamayı Türkçe veya İngilizce kullanabilirsin.

Halı saha maçı kurmak, kadro toplamak ve oyuncu bulmak hiç bu kadar kolay olmamıştı. Bir sonraki maçın Altıpas'ta.

652120057.description:
Akakçe
Türkiye’nin ilk fiyat karşılaştırma platformu Akakçe ile online alışveriş siteleri ve mağazalardaki ürün fiyatlarını kolayca karşılaştırabilirsiniz. İndirimleri kaçırmamak için fiyat takibi yapabilir, Efsane Cuma ve 11.11 gibi kampanya dönemlerinden anında haberdar olabilirsiniz. 2000 yılından bu yana Bim, A101, Şok aktüel katalogları ve binlerce satıcıya ait fiyatlar parmaklarınızın ucunda. Akakçe Market ile en ucuz sepeti bulabilir, ürün karşılaştırma, günün fırsatları, sezon kampanyaları ve Black Friday indirimlerini tek ekranda görüntüleyerek avantajlı alışverişin tadını çıkarabilirsiniz.

“Akakçe En Ucuzu Bulmak İçindir” sloganı ile her alışveriş öncesi zihinlerdeki yerini koruyan Akakçe’de ikinci el fırsatları da yer almaktadır. Son 6 ayın en ucuz fiyatlı ürünlerini ve son yakalanan indirimleri bulabileceğiniz gibi, Sevgililer Günü ile yılbaşı gibi özel günler için de en güzel hediyeler arasından tercih yapma imkanına sahipsiniz. Uygulamayla barkod okutarak fiyat karşılaştırması yapmak da mümkün! Satın almak istediğiniz ürünün fiyatlarını görüntülemek için uygulamayı indirip, ürün barkodunu okutmanız yeterli!

Akakçe ile sepette indirimle en ucuza gelen ürünleri keşfetmek de artık çok kolay. Ürünlerin liste fiyatına ek olarak yalnızca sepette uygulanan özel indirimleri görüntüleyebilir; en ucuz fiyatlara ulaşarak avantajlı alışverişin keyfini çıkarabilirsiniz. Bununla birlikte belirli bir süreyle sınırlı olan kampanyaları kaçırmamak için ana sayfada yer alan geri sayım sayacını takip edebilir, birçok mağazanın indirimlerinden anında haberdar olabilirsiniz.

Fiyat Karşılaştırması
Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Amazon Türkiye, n11 ve Pazarama gibi online alışveriş siteleriyle birlikte Migros, A101, Bim, Şok market ve Apple, Nike, Mavi, Samsung, Xiaomi gibi markaların indirimli ürün ve kampanyalarını tek yerde görebilir, fiyat karşılaştırması yaparak en uygun seçeneğe kolayca ulaşabilirsiniz. Tablet, telefon, televizyon, notebook, oyun bilgisayarı, termos, airfryer, güneş kremi, dolap, bebek bezi ve otomobil gibi birçok kategoride fiyatı düşen binlerce üründen haberdar olabilir, internet alışveriş siteleri arasındaki fiyat farkını anında öğrenerek avantajlı alışveriş yapma fırsatı yakalayabilirsiniz.

Alarm Kur, Fiyat Değişimlerinden Anında Haberdar Ol!

Fiyat alarmı ile en ucuz fiyatları yakalamak artık çok daha kolay! Beğendiğin ürüne alarm kurarak fiyatı düştüğünde anında bildirim alabilir, tasarruflu alışveriş fırsatını kaçırmadan değerlendirebilirsin. Elektronik, cep telefonu, beyaz eşya, kulaklık ve daha yüzlerce kategorideki indirimleri fiyat alarmı ile ilk sen öğren. Fiyat geçmişi grafiği sayesinde ise ürünün 1 hafta, 1 ay, 6 ay ve 1 yıllık fiyat değişimini görüntüleyebilir, istatistiksel modelleme ve makine öğrenmesi ile hazırlanan fiyat tahmini sayesinde de önümüzdeki 15 gün içindeki olası fiyat hareketlerini görebilirsin. Hemen alarm kur, fırsatları erkenden yakala!

Akakçe Aktüel
Akakçe aktüel ile Migroskop, A101 broşür, Şok broşür ve Bim aktüel’de yer alan bütün indirimli ürünleri inceleyebilirsiniz. Yalnızca A101 ve Bim indirimleri değil; Gratis, Watsons ve Rossman gibi birçok kozmetik mağazası ile MediaMarkt ve Teknosa gibi teknoloji marketlerin de mağaza indirimleri için hazırladığı kataloglara erişebilir, broşür içerisinde yer alan ürünlerin fiyat karşılaştırmasını da inceleyerek, broşürdeki fiyatın en ucuz olup olmadığını da öğrenebilirsiniz! 

Akakçe Market
Akakçe market, online alışverişlerinizde en uygun seçenekleri sizinle buluşturur. Piyasadaki en ucuz market fiyatlarını görmenizi sağlayan Akakçe market sayesinde, oluşturduğunuz sepetin nerede daha ucuza dolacağını öğrenmek için sepet karşılaştırması yapmak mümkün! Böylelikle marketlerdeki indirimli ürünler ile alışveriş yapabilir, en uygun fiyata en iyi alışveriş deneyimini yaşayabilirsiniz.

Phone Tracker - Family Locator is an application that uses GPS technology to help you locate and keep track of your family members, friends, and loved ones in real-time on a live, private map. This feature can help you ensure that your loved ones are safe by automatically letting you know their whereabouts, without any effort from them.

In case of emergencies, the app includes an SOS function that sends an urgent push notification to all members of your circle when you tap on the SOS button, along with a live update of your location. This feature ensures that your child, partner, or friend can alert you any time they need help or are in danger.

Other features of the app include the ability to view the location history of each circle member, find a lost device using the GPS phone tracker, and manage group circles and geofence zones.

Phone Tracker is your reliable GPS-based family locator and personal tracking app, designed to help keep your loved ones safe. It is not intended for spying or secret surveillance, and it cannot be installed remotely or without consent. 1575333906.description:
RAHATLIĞIN EN TEKNOLOJİK HALİ ARTIK CEBİNDE
Skechers, konforu ve teknolojiyi bir araya getiren ayakkabı ve spor giyim koleksiyonlarıyla modern yaşamın temposuna uyum sağlar. Artık Skechers dünyasına dilediğin her yerden ulaşabilir, favori modellerini kolayca keşfedebilirsin. Skechers App ile alışveriş; ürün incelemeden sipariş oluşturmaya kadar hızlı, pratik ve kişisel bir deneyime dönüşür.
Uygulama üzerinden kadın, erkek ve çocuk koleksiyonlarını inceleyebilir; ayakkabı, sneaker, spor giyim ve aksesuar seçenekleri arasında kolayca gezinebilirsin. Gelişmiş filtreleme seçenekleri sayesinde beden, renk, kategori ve fiyat aralığına göre aradığın ürüne daha hızlı ulaşabilir, alışveriş deneyimini kolaylaştırabilirsin.
KONFORUN YENİ ADRESİ
Skechers, sadece bir marka değil; konforun günlük hayatla buluştuğu bir yaşam tarzıdır. Ayak şeklini alan hafızalı tabanlar, nefes alan kumaşlar, hafif yapılar ve esnek tasarımlar sayesinde gün boyu rahatlık sunar. Yürüyüşten şehir yaşamına, işten hafta sonu planlarına kadar her adımda Skechers konforunu hissedebilirsin.
Kadın, erkek ve çocuk koleksiyonlarında farklı yaşlara ve ihtiyaçlara uygun modeller bulunur. Uzun süre ayakta kaldığın günlerde bile destek sunan tasarımlar, günlük tempona uyum sağlar. Skechers ile konfor, günün her anında seninle olur.
TEKNOLOJİYLE GELEN RAHATLIK
Her Skechers modeli, konforu artıran yenilikçi teknolojilerle geliştirilir. Air-Cooled Memory Foam, darbe emici taban yapıları ve destekleyici sistemler sayesinde adımların daha dengeli ve rahat hale gelir. Günlük kullanımda, yürüyüşte veya aktif yaşamda ihtiyacın olan hafifliği ve desteği sunar.
Gelişmiş taban teknolojileri ayağına uyum sağlayarak daha konforlu bir yürüyüş deneyimi oluşturur. Böylece hem hareket özgürlüğünü korur hem de gün boyu rahat hissetmeni sağlar.
MODERN STİL, SPORTİF ENERJİ
Skechers App ile sneakers, spor ayakkabı, eşofman, sweatshirt, tişört ve aksesuar koleksiyonlarını kolayca keşfedebilirsin. Modern kesimler, fonksiyonel kumaşlar ve ikonik detaylar sayesinde günlük kombinlerinden sportif şıklığa kadar farklı tarzlara uyum sağlayan parçalar bulabilirsin.
Minimal tasarımlardan dikkat çekici modellere kadar uzanan geniş ürün yelpazesiyle Skechers, stilini rahatlıkla tamamlar. Günlük kullanımda konfor ve şıklığı bir arada sunar.


DÜNYANIN TERCİHİ, SENİN STİLİN
1992’den bu yana konforun sınırlarını yeniden tanımlayan Skechers, bugün dünya genelinde milyonlarca kullanıcı tarafından tercih ediliyor. Yenilikçi teknolojileri, zamansız tasarımları ve geniş ürün seçenekleriyle her yaştan kullanıcıya hitap eder.
Dünyanın dört bir yanında tercih edilen Skechers konforu, şimdi senin de günlük stilinin vazgeçilmez bir parçası olmaya hazır.
ONLINE ALIŞVERİŞTE YENİ DÖNEM
Skechers App ile alışverişin kolay ve keyifli halini deneyimle. Yeni sezon ürünlerini keşfet, favorilerine ekle, güvenli ödeme seçenekleriyle siparişini oluştur. Uygulamaya özel kampanyalar, outlet fırsatları ve sürpriz avantajlarla alışveriş deneyimini daha avantajlı hale getir.
Kullanıcı dostu arayüz sayesinde ürünler arasında hızlıca gezebilir, ihtiyacına uygun modelleri kısa sürede bulabilirsin. Sana özel bildirimlerle kampanyalardan anında haberdar olabilir, fırsatları kaçırmadan alışverişini tamamlayabilirsin.
Uygulamayı indir, Skechers rahatlığını cebinde taşı. Çok Rahat, Çok Hayat!

1151811380.description:
Have you wanted to catch a fish, but you couldn't go to your favorite fishing spots? Have you been dissatisfied with casual fishing games? Play Fishing Clash – a free multiplayer fishing game chosen by millions of anglers and bring fishing and life together! 

Fishing Clash mixes the best features of multiplayer fishing games: the realism of simulator games, the competitiveness of sports games & the social aspect of fishing and hunting apps. With fishing spots from all over the world, it's the most realistic simulator amongst multiplayer fishing games.

How to quickly catch a fish in Fishing Clash?
• Launch the game.
• Tap the ""Cast"" button in the bottom-right corner.
• Tap the ""Strike"" button continuously to ensure the line tension indicator is in the center of the top bar.
• Enjoy the look of the fish on your fishing hook!

What's next?
• Relax, catch more fish, or win matches in exciting multiplayer duel mode.
• Take part in multiplayer challenges and championships.
• Upgrade your lure cards to level up and unlock new fishing spots.
• Conquer the fishing world!

Fishing around the world
In this multiplayer simulator, you can find a fishery almost everywhere: from the Florida Coast and the Kenai River to Lake Biwa, Galapagos, and Loch Ness. Here you can find a fishery almost everywhere in the world! Catch lots of fish like bass, carp, trout, and even some monster fish from the Deep Sea!

Collect and upgrade lure cards
Winning duels or getting top positions in championships will reward you with packs of lure cards. Collect them like in collectible card games and upgrade them to catch bigger fish! The bigger they are, the bigger the chance to win competitive multiplayer games and fishing world cup tournaments!

A simulator with real-time duels
Feel the thrill of multiplayer games and play a fishing duel against other anglers. You'll need not only skills but also your wits! Become a fishing master, get the biggest catch on your fishing hook and win every fishing battle.

Take part in live events
Every day you can hunt for amazing rewards like new rods, lure cards, and skill tokens in daily or weekly events. Pass the fishing trial, challenge angry sharks, become a catfish hunter or a traveler catching the biggest fish on a few different fishing spots!

Join or create a clan
Although Fishing Clash is a simulator at its heart, it enables ways to socialize like in free fishing apps. Meet fellow anglers, chat, exchange (or donate!) lure cards, and work together for great rewards in multiplayer Clan Wars.

The better the skills, the better your catch
All fishing spots have their skill tree. Use skill tokens to unlock new skills and get bonuses for fish of all rarities, and more!

Breathtaking fishing locations
Whether you prefer fly fishing, ice fishing, or trolling, you'll admire the look of all fishing spots. Every fishery in Fishing Clash features beautiful 3D vistas and hand-crafted fish you'll love to see on your fishing hook. It's a realistic simulator, after all.

Fresh, new content every week!
New fish, new fishery, new rods: in this realistic simulator, you can find new content every week, so there's no shortage of fish to catch! Bring fishing and life together!

Whether you're a seasoned angler or a multiplayer simulation games fan, Fishing Clash is a great casual time-killer. With dozens of fishing spots worldwide and hundreds of fish species, it offers an excellent experience for anybody looking for a realistic fishing simulator. DOWNLOAD NOW!

6443518532.description:
Keep score for your padel matches right from your Apple Watch. One tap, one point, without missing a beat. And it's free!

How many points have you argued over because of a "Was it 30-15 or 40-15?" When you're giving it your all on the court, it's easy to lose track. With Padel Watch you forget about the scoreboard, not the points: you play, your wrist keeps score, and afterward you break the match down in detail on your iPhone.

• Score points in under a second: Glance at your watch, tap the team that won the point, and keep playing. No phones, no arguments.
• Matches your way: points per set, advantage or golden point, with or without tie-break, advantage, golden point, or the new star point. You decide!
• The serve, always clear: The serve indicator manages the order for you, and you can fix it mid-match if you switch the order between sets. No more "Whose serve is it?"
• Turn your match into a workout: Switch on workout mode and log heart rate, distance, and calories in an activity session, just like the Apple Watch's native tennis workouts.
• Made a mistake? Undo it: Go back to the previous score with a single tap, in seconds, without affecting your final stats.
• Battery for all three sets: Padel Watch uses little battery and lasts the whole match. (Workout mode may increase battery use.)
• Your history, always with you: Every match is saved on your watch and your iPhone. Relive the best moments whenever you want and easily log your results in your favorite padel apps.
• Pro-level stats: On your iPhone, analyze every match set by set: the longest point streak, break points converted by each team, the percentage of points won, your overall progress, and much more.

Keeping score on the Apple Watch and in the iPhone app is free. Advanced stats are unlocked with a subscription.

You can subscribe and pay through your Apple ID in the App Store. Payment will be charged to your account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the end of the period. 6796725037.description:
Every court deserves a scoreboard — yours is now the phone at the side of it.

This app turns the phone at the side of the court into a real scoreboard.
You enter points with a cheap Bluetooth remote and hear the score out loud.
Nobody stops mid-match to argue about the score again.

HOW IT WORKS
• Press the Bluetooth remote to score — no need to touch the phone
• The score is announced out loud: "thirty - forty"
• The announcer adds colour at the big moments and chats between sets
• Mount the phone courtside; the screen stays on and reads from metres away
• Got a smartwatch? Score from your wrist: points, whose serve and which side (Apple Watch)
• No remote? Tap the screen instead

TOURNAMENT MODE — AMERICANO AND MEXICANO
Run your club's tournament from your phone: Americano or Mexicano; individual,
fixed pairs or mixed doubles. Players join with a code and follow their own
match and ranking from their own phone.
• Rounds and pairings are built for you; you pick who keeps the score
• Standings, points and medals update live
• Your club logo and sponsor images appear on the tournament screens and the live board
• Read player names from a photo: snap the club's list and let the names fill in
• If the court loses signal the score is kept on the phone and syncs when it returns
• Export the results as CSV
The live board is at skortabelasi.com/t/CODE — put it on the screen by the court.

FULL PADEL, TENNIS & PICKLEBALL RULES
• Golden point (default) or advantage
• Tie-break, super tie-break, deciding game, advantage set
• Adjustable set length and number of sets, plus an unlimited mode
• Four-player serve rotation — always know who serves next
• Change-ends reminder
• Unlimited undo

PICKLEBALL
The full rulebook: side-out serving (only the serving team scores), games to 11/15/21, best of 3, server number. The announcer calls it the pickleball way: "4-3-2".

AMERICANO MATCH TYPE
Club doesn't run its tournament in the app? Play an Americano match on its own: one match to 16/21/24/32 points, no games or sets, the serve rotates every 2 or 4 points, a draw is possible.

WORKS WITH ANY REMOTE
Not tied to one brand: "Learn key" records what your remote actually sends. On a single button, one click is your point, two clicks theirs, hold to undo.

YOUR MATCH IS NEVER LOST
Close the app or let the phone die — the match resumes where it left off, and recent matches stay in history.

FOUR LANGUAGES, REAL ANNOUNCER VOICES
Turkish, English, French and Spanish — interface and announcements. Two announcer voices per language. Two languages on court? Turn on the second announcement language and every score is called in both.

PICK YOUR COMMENTATOR'S STYLE
Same voice, three attitudes: Sharp (teases the losing side), Balanced (classic commentary), Warm (looks after both sides). Turkish announcements for now; other languages are next.

ACCOUNT IS OPTIONAL
The app is fully usable without an account and asks for no personal details. If you create one (a code sent to your e-mail, no password): your settings and match history follow you across devices, you add friends by QR code or invite link, matches you play together land in both histories, and a friend can watch your score live on their own phone.

The free version shows a short ad when a match ends — never mid-game. The Ad-Free subscription removes ads entirely; you pay with one tap through the store.

Tournament Pro and Tournament Elite make the tournament bigger: more players and courts, club logo and name, sponsor images and the sponsor report. The free tier still runs a tournament with four players on one court.

Subscriptions (Ad-Free, Tournament Pro, Tournament Elite; monthly or yearly) renew automatically. The price is shown on the purchase screen; cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Tek hesapla birden fazla tesise üye ol, tesisler arasında tek dokunuşla geçiş yap. Her tesisin bildirimleri kendi çatısı altında düzenli kalır.

INDOOR AND BEACH IN ONE APP
• Two real courts — the 18 × 9 m hall and the 16 × 8 m beach court, both drawn to FIVB dimensions
• Switch any play between them — the court belongs to the play, so your indoor and beach work lives side by side in one library
• The courts differ the way they really do: the hall has an attack line 3 m either side of the net inside a coloured free zone; the beach court is a plain rectangle divided only by the net
• Playing formats that match — 6v6 indoors, 2v2 on the sand
• Built for clubs that play indoor in winter and beach in summer, without paying for two apps

SQUAD & ROTATION PLANNER
• Build your squad once — numbers, names, positions, team colour

TACTICS BOARD
• Multi-scene plays — sequence serve, reception, set and attack, then replay it as an animation
• Drawing tools — solid, dotted, dashed and wavy arrows, a multi-point line tool, freehand, arrowheads at either or both ends, two stroke widths
• Customizable players — colour, number, name, position
• Volleyball positions — S, OH, MB, OP, L
• Rotations where they happen — lay out a 5-1 and draw the switch from serve-receive into attack

• Pro upgrade unlocks multi-scene plays and sharing

WHO IT'S FOR
• Coaches running youth and senior practice

• Parents coaching kids' teams who want simple, fair rotation

Squads and plays you create stay on your device until you publish a play. Published plays live on our server with a random ID. No tracking, no ads, no account required.

1626101352.description:
Get ready to take control of your padel tournaments like never before! Download today and experience the ultimate app for organizing your padel tournaments!

Whether you're an event organizer, a passionate padel player, or a club owner, this app is your all-in-one solution for seamless tournament management.

You will never have to worry about "Who is going to play with whom?", "Who tracks the points?", "Who's winning?" - We will take care of everything!

POPULAR TOURNAMENTS
Americano: Americano is a popular tournament format in padel where players compete in teams of two. It follows a round-robin format, where each team plays against every other team in the tournament. The team with the highest number of wins emerges as the champion. This format guarantees intense and exciting matches throughout the tournament.

Mexicano: Mexicano is a thrilling padel tournament format that combines elements of singles and doubles play. Each team consists of three players, and matches are played in a rotating format. The three players take turns playing singles matches against the opposing team, resulting in a dynamic and strategic gameplay experience. Mexicano offers a unique twist to traditional padel tournaments.

Mixicano: Mixicano is a fun and inclusive padel tournament format that promotes gender diversity and teamwork. It is a mixed doubles tournament where each team consists of one male and one female player. Mixicano tournaments encourage players of all skill levels to participate and enjoy the sport together. With its emphasis on balance and cooperation, Mixicano creates an engaging and supportive atmosphere for players.

NUMBER OF PARTICIPANTS
Our app is designed to accommodate any number of players, unlike other apps in the market. We specialize in creating a tournament generator that can effectively manage varying player counts, whether it's low, high, or uneven.

THE SCORING SYSTEM
Based on a predetermined number of points per game (e.g. 21 points) the team that takes the most number of points will be the winner of the match. This also means that being the winner or loser of the match is irrelevant. The reason for this is that each point counts in your individual results. As a player you should always aim to get as many points as possible, it will not be the same to win 20 to 1 than 11 to 10.

Privacy & Terms
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Read our full Terms of Use & Privacy Policy:

6759404437.description:
Turn your phone into a football video analysis desk: import a match, freeze any moment, and let the AI read the frame for you.
Coaches, analysts and players use TacticalSnap to break down tactics, draw on the pitch and share the clip in minutes.

Import a match from your camera roll and TacticalSnap watches it for you: the AI scans the whole film on your device and marks every goal attempt on the timeline.

JUMP STRAIGHT TO THE ACTION
Shots, headers, free kicks, penalties, saves, box attacks and set pieces land on the timeline as colour-coded markers, counted by type. Tap one and the video jumps two seconds early, so you see the build-up. Skip event to event with one button, follow the white scene-cut lines to the start of a move, and pinch the filmstrip to zoom to 10x.

FREEZE ANY MOMENT
Pause and tap Scan. One tap finds the players, splits the two teams by shirt colour, reads the pitch and draws each player's last seconds of movement onto the frame. If the keeper lands on the wrong side, fix it with a chip and the correction is back-filled onto every marker. Step frame by frame, at speeds from 0.25x to 2x.

SEE WHAT THE COACH SEES
• Passing lanes from the player on the ball — open in green, blocked in red
• Pitch control, empty-space maps and pressure counts, so a 3v2 is obvious
• Player trails, vision cones and team shape chains
• Heatmaps and a magnifier for the detail a wide shot hides
• Tactical grid, team width and depth, player distances in metres — when the pitch is calibrated

DRAW YOUR POINT
Twelve drawing tools on the frozen frame: arrows, lines, circles, freehand, zones, running paths, text notes, player connections, laser pointer and spotlight. Drop a ghost to show where the run should have gone.

TOP-DOWN TACTICS BOARD
Flip the frame into a 2D board built from the real player positions, then drag a player where they should have been — their real position stays as a ghost on a dashed line. Or open the blank board for a clean plan and export a PNG. On iPad it adds formation presets and step-by-step play frames.

Hand-Drawn turns the frozen frame into a tactical poster: the pitch drawn to real dimensions, the players cut straight out of your video. Nothing is faked.

PROVE IT WITH NUMBERS
• Match Report — the rhythm of the match, its busiest stretch, longest break, loudest moments and possession. Every row taps straight to that second
• Spatial Analytics — team heatmaps side by side: players, width, depth and, when calibrated, distance covered
• Honest metrics — the map reads yellow when the pitch is calibrated and orange when positions are estimated, and without calibration you get percentages, never invented metres

COMPARE TWO MOMENTS
Put last week beside this week and play both at the same second — any project or saved clip — and draw across the pair.

RECORD AND SHARE
Hit Rec on a frozen frame and talk while you draw — your voice, drawings, spotlight, board and comparisons all land in one clip. Line the clips into a reel, add music, pick 16:9 for the meeting room or 9:16 for the group chat, then share. Or let Auto-reel build the cut from the loudest moments.

WHO IT'S FOR
Grassroots and Sunday league coaches, academy, youth, women's and girls' teams, video analysts and scouts, players studying their own game, parents filming from the stands. iPad, Apple Pencil, keyboard shortcuts and voice commands supported. Any footage works — a phone from the stands, a tripod behind the goal or a recorded broadcast.

NO ACCOUNT, NO CLOUD
Every analysis runs offline on your device. Your match video never leaves your phone, there is nothing to sign up for, no server doing the work.

Also supports American football — pick your sport on first launch, or switch a project any time.

ORGANIZE YOUR OWN MATCH
Create a listing in just a few seconds: choose the format, date, time, neighborhood, maximum number of players, and skill level. DESIGNED FOR PEOPLE WHO LOVE THE GAME

686449807.description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.
